scripts.dev: npm run build -w @idx/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @idx/api" "npm run dev -w @idx/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @idx/contracts && npm run build -w @idx/api && npm run build -w @idx/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @idx/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @idx/contracts && npm run test -w @idx/api && npm run test -w @idx/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build -w @idx/contracts && npm run test:coverage -w @idx/api && npm run test:coverage -w @idx/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @idx/contracts && npm run test:integration -w @idx/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run format:check
scripts.verify:ci: npm run check && npm run test:coverage
